 Iranians hold a cartoon placard of US President Donald Trump during a rally marking the 47th anniversary of the 1979 US embassy takeover, outside the former embassy building in Tehran, Iran, on November 4, 2026 [Abedin Taherkenareh/EPA] By Enes Abuomer and Ahmad Elmouniery Published On 6 Nov 2026 6 Nov 2026 Save

 US President Donald Trump says the US may have to “destroy” the rest of Iran and that rebuilding will take 25 years, adding that people will “know soon enough” if he acts.
 Iran has reportedly sent a nuclear proposal to the US through Qatari mediators, which Washington is reviewing while Tehran waits for its seven demands to be met.
